source_contract: Actual IFEval mode invokes trusted source predicates inside ScriptSpec; native no-comma predicate reused. Original strict/loose response variants, descriptor defaults and client aggregate schema retained. Source Python RNG state transferred and restored only after complete result validation.
scoring_fixes: Language detection failure returns zero; source returns true. Detector seed0 explicitly fixes otherwise nondeterministic source language behavior.
Absent/misaligned/unknown constraints, duplicate prompts, blank or empty-matching keyword references, vacuous lower bounds and reversed spans/ranges are invalid tasks.
Malformed child metrics/flags or nonfinite Gaussian RNG state abort without mutating host RNG.
limitations: IFEval saved responses are real-response source parity, not reproduction of a validated archived score. One original prompt has no exact match and is listed in the frozen census.
IFBench responses are synthetic fixtures with all300 genuine source metadata rows.
IFEval run_benchmark has an unrelated source typo; actual evaluate_responses scoring boundary was tested, not the full generation driver.
Source vendored predicates retain optional language and NLTK dependencies; no new core dependency or verifier class.
